# Image Aspect Ratio Calculator

> Find your image aspect ratio, calculate exact pixel dimensions, frame or beautify screenshots locally, and check video, ultrawide, and social media dimensions. Free browser-based tools maintained by wherexml.

## Tools
- [Image aspect ratio calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/): Read pixel dimensions and exact reduced aspect ratio from a local photo, then preview padding (Fit) or centered crop (Fill) in common frames.
- [Make image square](https://imageaspectratio.com/make-image-square): Pad a local photo with a solid, blurred, or transparent background—or crop and reposition it—then download a 1:1 PNG or JPEG up to 4096 px.
- [Change image aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/change-image-aspect-ratio): Crop or pad a local photo to 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, or custom ratios without stretching and download a PNG or JPEG up to 4096 px.
- [Add padding & border to image](https://imageaspectratio.com/add-padding-to-image): Add symmetric or custom white, colored, or transparent PNG borders around any photo locally up to 4096 px.
- [Round corners & circle crop](https://imageaspectratio.com/round-corners-image): Apply smooth rounded corners or a 1:1 circle mask to any image and export a transparent PNG locally.
- [Screenshot Beautifier](https://imageaspectratio.com/screenshot-beautifier): Open or paste (`Cmd/Ctrl+V`) a local screenshot, frame on studio gradients, ambient blur, or solid backgrounds, annotate with curved arrows (`A`), step badges (`N`), text callouts (`T`), freehand ink (`P`), highlighter (`H`), spotlight (`S`), Gaussian blur (`B`), or mosaic pixelation (`M`), and export flattened PNG or JPEG up to 4096 px.
- [Annotate screenshot](https://imageaspectratio.com/annotate-screenshot): Add curved arrows, numbered step badges, highlight boxes, and text callouts to screenshots locally in browser.
- [Blur & pixelate screenshot](https://imageaspectratio.com/blur-screenshot): Permanently redact sensitive emails, API keys, and tokens using flattened Gaussian blur or mosaic pixelation before exporting.
- [Aspect ratio calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/calculator): Find an aspect ratio from width and height, solve a matching width or height in pixels, or scale dimensions using exact fraction math.
- [16:9 aspect ratio calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/16-9-aspect-ratio-calculator): Solve width or height at exact 16:9 in whole pixels; apply 640×360 to 3840×2160 examples.
- [Video aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/video-aspect-ratio): Enter dimensions to compare widescreen and vertical frame fit; assumes square pixels.
- [Ultrawide calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/ultrawide-aspect-ratio-calculator): Distinguish exact pixel ratios (43:18, 64:27, 12:5) from the 21:9 marketing category.

## Social media dimensions & safe zones
- [TikTok, Reels & Shorts safe zone checker](https://imageaspectratio.com/safe-zone-checker): Preview 1080×1920 vertical frames against TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts UI overlays and download a transparent PNG guide.
- [Instagram 3:4 grid & carousel splitter](https://imageaspectratio.com/instagram-grid-splitter): Slice seamless 4:5 carousels or 3:4 profile grids in reverse post order and download numbered slides or a ZIP archive locally.
- [Fit photo to Instagram without cropping](https://imageaspectratio.com/fit-photo-to-instagram): Fit full landscape or tall vertical photos into Instagram 4:5 (1080×1350) or 3:4 frames with blurred or solid borders.
- [OG image 1200×630 safe zone tester](https://imageaspectratio.com/og-image-safe-zone): Preview unpublished local 1200×630 Open Graph images across X, LinkedIn, Discord, Slack, iMessage, and WhatsApp 1:1 crops, and export a <280 KB JPG.
- [Social media aspect ratios](https://imageaspectratio.com/social-media): Compare recommended dimensions and aspect ratios across TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram placements.
- [TikTok aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/tiktok-aspect-ratio): Plan a 9:16 (1080×1920) vertical frame; distinguish working examples from ad specifications.
- [YouTube aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/youtube-aspect-ratio): Calculate 16:9 landscape dimensions and understand adaptive playback.
- [Instagram Reel aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/instagram-reel-aspect-ratio): Plan a 9:16 (1080×1920) vertical video; distinguish accepted shapes and 3:4 profile grid cover framing.
- [Instagram Story aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/instagram-story-aspect-ratio): Plan a 9:16 portrait photo/video canvas and distinguish Story ad guidance.
- [YouTube Shorts aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/youtube-shorts-aspect-ratio): Compare vertical 9:16 and square 1:1 geometry; consult official classification rules.

## Learn
- [What is aspect ratio?](https://imageaspectratio.com/what-is-aspect-ratio): An illustrated guide to width:height, common ratios, exact calculations, cropping, padding, and stretching.
- [Exact fractions vs rounded pixels](https://imageaspectratio.com/exact-fractions-vs-rounded-pixels): How reduced ratios, whole-pixel scaling, rounding direction, exact crops, and CSS aspect-ratio behave in practice.

## Limitations
Calculations use exact integer fractions; rounded pixel values are labeled. Fit/Fill are previews. Make image square, Change image aspect ratio, and Screenshot Beautifier export a local PNG or JPEG rendered in the browser up to 4096 px (no batch, AI fill, or video transcoding). Selected or pasted images stay locally in the browser and are never uploaded to a server. Open-source availability and indexability do not imply search engine ranking or endorsement.
